train_altogether: run the altogether training loop with a CLIP model and captioner model on image-text data
create_captioner: create a captioner model from a named class in mini_clip using clipcap_args and a device
gen_sample0: generate caption samples from image features using the GPT model and log ground truth versus generated text
llm_decode: decode a list of generated token IDs into human-readable strings using an LLM tokenizer
review_train_altogether: review the altogether training loop that encodes images with CLIP and trains a captioner with cross-entropy loss
